events.title: The Park Keeper Demo Launches on October 15!
events.summary: Hello, future rangers!We’re excited to announce that The Park Keeper Demo will be available on October 15.Welcome to Hampton Bay. You’re the new ranger, and tourist season is about to begin. Check visitors’ documents, inspect their vehicles, and decide who gets through the gate.
